en-us.jp_neon_sing_small: Choose songs and sing in a small karaoke room.
en-us.jp_neon_sing_party: Take turns singing in a party karaoke room.
en-us.neon_sing_begin: $doer.firstname$ selects a song and picks up the microphone.
en-us.neon_sing_ongoing: $doer.firstname$ sings along with the lyrics on screen.
en-us.neon_sing_end: $doer.firstname$ puts down the microphone and browses the next page of songs.
